title: First Meeting — No Tail at the Outpost

sequences.description: Open on Aristotle standing on the landing pad, painted wasteland + outpost behind him.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: League wreckage everywhere. Twelve scouts, two gunships. One shooter did all this.

sequences.description: Camera glides 3/4 behind-and-above Aristotle as he walks toward the painted outpost.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: Whoever's inside picked every shot to disable. That's not luck.

sequences.description: Tight over-shoulder on Aristotle, painted door dominating frame.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: Warning light's active on the blast door. Someone sealed it from the inside.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: Scorch marks around the frame — they tried to breach this door and couldn't. Whoever's in there built this place to last.

options.label: Hold the line — wait for whoever's inside to make a move

sequences.description: Aristotle tries hailing before the door opens.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: Outpost, this is Captain Aristotle of the Felid Corsairs. Friendly approach. Do you copy?

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: No response. Either they can't hear me or they don't want to talk. Only one way to find out.

sequences.description: Invisible Door animation runs (Door node inside hidden .glb); narration plays; NoTail fades in at his world-space doorway position before the next walk sequence carries him forward.

lines.text: A grinding of metal. The blast door shudders, then rises.

sequences.description: Camera slides to the side (in parallel with the walk). NoTail walks out of the painted doorway toward Aristotle.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Stop right there.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Hands where I can see them, Captain. Or the next thing you see is the inside of a body bag.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: Easy. I'm not League. Felid Corsair — Captain Aristotle. We picked up the fighting on sensors.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Corsair. Great. Last Corsair who came through here promised reinforcements. That was three weeks ago.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: I'm still waiting.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: Looks like you managed on your own. That's a lot of League wreckage for one cat.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Twelve scouts. Two gunships. They thought one outpost with one defender wasn't worth a proper assault force.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: They were wrong.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: I can see that. You're No Tail, aren't you? I've heard stories.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Stories don't hold positions. Ammunition does. Speaking of which — mine's getting low.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: So either say something useful or move along.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Sensors are lighting up. More League scouts, coming in from the dust belt. They're regrouping for another push.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: How many?

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Enough. Words are cheap, Captain. I've watched a hundred talkers run at the first sign of League cruisers.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: So here's the deal. Help me finish this. Fight beside me, right here, right now. Then we'll talk.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: And if I say I'd rather handle this from the ship?

options.label: Provide fire support from the ship

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Good answer. Take the left flank. Don't get in my line of fire. And Captain?

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: Yeah?

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Try to keep up.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: You didn't run.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: Was that a compliment?

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: It's an observation. Most Corsairs I've met talk big and fly fast in the wrong direction. You stayed.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: You needed a hand. It wasn't complicated.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: No. It wasn't. That's what I liked about it.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: My outpost is gone. My crew — what was left of them — evacuated weeks ago. I stayed because someone had to hold the line. But the line's moved now.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: What will you do?

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: My guns still work. My aim hasn't slipped. And I've got nowhere else to be.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: So. Need a gunner, Captain?

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: The guns are yours. Welcome aboard, No Tail.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Right then. Show me the weapons systems.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: Deck two, forward battery. Four pulse cannons, two torpedo tubes. They could use someone who knows how to—

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: I'll figure it out. I always do.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: One rule, Captain. When I say 'fire,' you don't second-guess me. In combat, hesitation kills.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: Fair enough. One rule from me — we don't shoot first unless we have to.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Fine. But when we do shoot, we shoot to end it. Point me at the enemy. I'll handle the rest.

lines.speaker: Aristotle
lines.text: I appreciate the offer. But I think your fight and mine are different roads.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: ...Fair. Safe skies, Captain.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: Figures. Fine — if you're gonna help, help. Hit the dust belt hard. I'll hold here.

lines.speaker: NoTail
lines.text: That's what I thought. Move along, Corsair.
